# AXE2 cord flex: specification for quotation (generated by rf2/rf2_cordflex.py; MODELED design, not a released drawing)

## 1. Function
Carries the coil transmit pair from the search head to the TXD pod on the shaft (s 400 mm), and head power, three RS-485-class differential pairs, three guarded analog reference pairs and (piece 2) the pod feed and clamp return between the head, the pod, REF3T and the hinge of the control chassis, through the 2-stage carbon telescope. Replaces a coiled cable.

## 2. Construction
- Single conductive layer, Kapton polyimide base, **1 mil Kapton / acrylic coverlay** both sides; about 0.15 mm per layer.
- **Selective copper:** 2 oz (0.0028 in) on TX_A, TX_B, VIN_H, GND_H; 0.5 oz on the signal and reference areas (contoured / selective plating). Rolled-annealed copper preferred (dynamic loop).
- Piece 1 width **18.24 mm** against the 18.6 mm inner bore less 2 mm = 16.6 mm: **does NOT fit (+1.64 mm; rule row 'cord-flex width vs bore less 2' BLOCKED / FAIL in docs/RULE_NEAR_MISSES.md: owner decision open)**.
- Piece 2 width **7.68 mm** (no TX strips past the pod). Lanes, edge to edge, piece 1:

## 3. Pieces and lengths
- **Piece 1 (dynamic):** head gland -> REF3T board, **961 mm**, with a rolling loop storing half of the 550 mm telescope travel; loop bend radius 6.0 mm (40 x stack; IPC single layer >= 6 x). The TX strips and the TXCMD / TXSTAT pairs end at the **TXD pod tap** (s 400 mm, 965 mm of TX strip from the head incl. the loop); the rest continues to REF3T.
- **Piece 2 (static):** REF3T -> hinge cord board, **394 mm**.
- Both inside the 40 in (1016 mm) preferred length of Tech Etch long flex; one-piece (1315 mm) only on a 5 ft (Minco) / 60 in (Tech Etch advanced) process.

## 4. Electrical requirements
- **High voltage (project rule 6):** TX_A / TX_B (piece 1, head -> pod) carry the coil flyback, 477 V peak (clamp); HV_CLAMP (piece 2) carries the clamp node DC to the regenerative buck. Spacing >= 1.0 mm HV-HV and HV-to-everything (measured minimum 1.0 / 1.0 mm). **Net-to-net hipot >= 1000 VRMS, 60 Hz, 30 s, <= 1 mA** (Minco typical; Kapton aged rating 2000-3000 V/mil, Sierra HV notebook). No sharp copper corners on TX (round all bends and pad ends).
- **Current:** TX 4.62 A rms (continuous boost at 14.14 A peak, 318 us flat-top; rf2_drive / rf2_continuous), traces 3.22 mm at 2 oz for a 10 K rise (IPC-2221 internal); loop resistance about 0.145 ohm out and back over 0.965 m. VIN_H / GND_H 0.45 A, 0.30 mm. VIN_T / GND_T (pod feed, piece 2) 2.0 A design, 1.02 mm. HV_CLAMP / GND_CLAMP 0.3 mm.
- **Capacitance:** TX strip pair about 30.6 pF/m (coplanar strips, eps_eff 1.6 ASSUMED): the vendor to report the measured value (it sets the first gate, rf2_timing_cord).
- **Reference pairs:** 0.15 / 0.15 mm pairs with 0.3 mm ground guards each side; guards tied at REF3T only. A 0.5 mm ground guard trace (0.3 mm gaps) separates the DATA pair from the REF group (owner 2026-10-31, variant option 'ref_guard').

## 5. Terminations
- TX strips: solder lands only (no connector on the TX strips): head gland board (TXJ) and the TXD pod tap. LV nets at the head gland: Panasonic Y5B 0.5 mm ZIFs on CB1D (10-way, VIN_H / GND_H on 2 pins each) and AB1A (10-way), flex ends stiffened to 0.30 mm (owner 2026-10-31, option 'gland_fpc'). REF3T board (joint of pieces 1 and 2) and the hinge cord board: solder lands.
- Strain relief: a pin through a loop of the flex at the gland boss (SDC 2300 coil-cable pin pattern); stiffeners (polyimide) under the land areas.

## 6. Environment and test
- -20 to +60 C use (acrylic adhesive rated -65 to 105 C); field moisture (potted gland ends).
- Tests: continuity, insulation resistance, the hipot above, dynamic flex life on the rolling loop (cycles to be agreed; telescoping several times per session), measured TX capacitance.

## 7. Open with the vendor
- Exact stack (adhesive vs adhesiveless), selective-copper process, RA copper in the loop, flex-life data at the 6 mm loop radius, price for 2 pieces vs 1.
